description: This file contains source code for managing git object files, including packing, unpacking, creation, reading, writing, integrity checks, and transaction management within a git repository. It includes functions for handling loose objects, packfiles, object signatures, and associated caching and consistency operations.

classes.name: struct odb_read_stream
classes.description: Abstracts a stream for reading objects from the odb, with specialized implementation for loose objects involving zlib inflating.

classes.name: struct odb_loose_read_stream
classes.description: Extends odb_read_stream for loose objects, managing zlib inflating, headers, and mappings.

classes.name: struct transaction_packfile
classes.description: Tracks temporary packfile state during transactions, including file name, hash, and written objects.

classes.name: struct odb_transaction
classes.description: Represents a transaction context for multiple object operations, including packfile and loose object handling.

classes.name: struct odb_source_loose
classes.description: Represents a source for loose objects with associated cache and state.

classes.name: struct oidtree
classes.description: Data structure for storing object IDs, used for caching loose objects.
